description.en: At night the moon darkens: the Bakunawa is swallowing it. Beat the gongs to make the serpent let go.
description.fil: Sa gabi, dumidilim ang buwan: nilulunok ito ng Bakunawa. Paluin ang mga gong para bitawan ito ng ahas.

sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
Damiana L. Eugenio, Philippine Folk Literature: The Myths (University of the Philippines Press, 1993)
